responses.text: Can't believe the Legion hit us in such numbers. They're stronger than we think.
I coughed up blood this morning. I think I'm really sick.
No attacks for a while now. That's a good sign, right?
I think there's something wrong with the food.
I swear I saw somebody sneaking out of the graveyard the other night.
Lieutenant Markland always looks like he's afraid the kids are gonna bite him.
Markland seems to be getting better with his bedside manner.
Finally got enough pills to chase off that damn infection.
Doc's gotten real handy with the kids these days.
Hope the Doc can give me some meds this week.
Nice to see more guards on patrol. Maybe Caesar won't murder us all.
Finally starting to get some decent food around here.
Not enough soldiers here to stop Caesar if he rolls through.
Haven't had a decent meal in weeks.
Legion just came out of nowhere.
